about: 2021 Census GCP G01/G07/G09F/G09G/G09H/G14/G32/G37/G49B/G60B SA1 tables, pooled to Victoria's 88 state electoral districts for the 26 November 2022 election (the 2021 redistribution's boundaries). Each SA1 counts whole to the district its polygon representative point lies in (boundary SA1s are not split; the state total is never moved). Bases match the federal stores (ex-not-stated): language other than English over English-only+other stated; age shares renormalised over G01's 11 bands (which exclude age-not-stated); overseas-born over country-stated, and the ten curated birthplace-country shares (cob, order in cobKeys) riding that same basis; university (bachelor and above) over the G01 aged-15+ population less level-of-education-not-stated; blue-collar (trades, machinery operators and drivers, labourers) over the eight stated ANZSCO groups; the new lane set mirrors the federal stores (year-12-or-less over G01's six printed stated schooling levels; G07 Tot-row Indigenous/ Indigenous-plus-non-Indigenous; G14's Religion menu ten shares (rel, key order in relKeys) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons basis; G37's Housing-tenure menu four shares (ten, key order in tenKeys) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis; G32's one-parent share of families; the under-15 share of the stated ages). p is census persons; n the SA1 count. The four Vic sentinel SA1s (migratory/offshore) carry no polygon and sit outside the join, holding 9124 persons statewide.
